en.title: Wings of the Azure Sky and the Path of Dancing Cherry Blossoms
en.premise: Leo, a young scrap scavenger, picks up a mysterious "broken sword" that fell from the sky, only to discover it is the key to awakening a legendary airship. Guided by unknown winds, Leo and his companions soar into the sea of clouds, setting their sights on the legendary "Sea of Cherry Blossom Clouds" that is said to restore the world. The pulse of machinery and the song of the wind drive them toward a brilliant adventure.

zh.title: 苍穹之翼与樱花舞动的风之航路
zh.premise: 废材回收少年里奥，偶然捡到了从天而降的神秘“断剑”，并发现它竟是启动传说中飞空艇的关键。在未知之风的指引下，里奥与伙伴们一同飞向云海，目标是传说中能够让世界重生的“樱花云海”。机械的律动与风之歌，正驱使着他们踏上辉煌的冒险之旅。
